headline: FCMB Group Pre-Tax Profit Expands 103% to N272.8 Billion in Nine Months
summary: Nigeria's FCMB Group reported a 103% increase in nine-month pre-tax profit to N272.8 billion, with assets under management growing to N2.1 trillion.
why: FCMB Group is a financial services holding company operating consumer banking, asset management, and pensions in Nigeria.
